faqs.question: Can I make a dandiya invitation card on my phone?
faqs.answer: Yes. Adobe Express, Canva and Kapwing all run in a browser, and a WhatsApp text needs only the chat. The Be My Dandiya Partner page also opens in any phone or laptop browser, with no app and no account needed by the person you send it to.

faqs.question: Does Kapwing put a watermark on invitation videos?
faqs.answer: On its $0 plan, yes. Kapwing's own pricing page says that plan gives unlimited exports with a watermark, up to 4 minutes long at 720p. Its Pro plan, $16 per member per month billed annually, removes the watermark.

faqs.question: Does Adobe Express add a watermark to a dandiya card?
faqs.answer: We could not confirm either way. The archived May 2026 copy of Adobe's plan table lists JPEG, PNG, PDF and GIF export on every plan but has no watermark row, and the live page blocked our fetcher. Export one test card before you design the full invitation.

faqs.question: What details should a garba or dandiya invitation include?
faqs.answer: Date, start time, venue, dress code and who to contact. Put the date and time in the text message as well as on the image, because a 2011 field experiment found that prompting people to note a date and a time raised turnout by 4.2 percentage points.

faqs.question: Can I send one invitation link to my whole society WhatsApp group?
faqs.answer: Not the Be My Dandiya Partner link. It asks one person "Will you be my Dandiya partner?" and emails you when that one person says yes, so it makes no sense to 200 people. For a group, post an image card with a typed line underneath.

faqs.question: How do I collect RSVPs for a society dandiya night?
faqs.answer: None of the image or video tools we read lists an RSVP feature, so ask guests to reply in the group with a headcount by a fixed date. Put that deadline in the text under the card, not only inside the image.

faqs.question: Is the Be My Dandiya Partner page free?
faqs.answer: Its own page schema marks it isAccessibleForFree: true. The person you send it to needs no app and no account, only a phone or laptop browser.

faqs.question: Can they actually say no on the dandiya partner invitation?
faqs.answer: Not really, and that is deliberate. The No button twirls away with a new excuse each time and turns into a second Yes after five tries, so treat it as a playful ask. If the answer might genuinely be no, ask in person first.

faqs.question: Does the dandiya invitation page work in Hindi or Gujarati?
faqs.answer: The page interface is English. Every line you write is editable, so test one line in your language in the preview before you publish.

faqs.question: What size should a dandiya invitation be for an Instagram Story?
faqs.answer: Instagram Story size is 1080×1920 pixels, which is the size of the Dandiya Pass PNG the partner page gives the recipient. For a society card, export the image at whatever size your WhatsApp group already uses.

faqs.question: When is Navratri in 2027?
faqs.answer: Sharad Navratri 2027 runs from 30 September to 8 October, with Dussehra on 9 October 2027. In 2026 it ran 11 to 19 October, with Vijayadashami on 20 October.

article.contentMarkdown:
# Dandiya Invitation Card Online Free: 5 Ways, Compared Honestly

Which route to a dandiya invitation card online free of cost suits you depends on one question: are you inviting a society of 200, or one person? For a group, design an image card and post it in the WhatsApp group with the date, time and venue typed underneath. For one person, a link that asks a question and waits for the answer does something no image can.

Two numbers from SubhSandesh's own pages shape that split. 48.3% of shared pages are opened on a phone (27,725 of 57,456 views), so the other half land on a laptop or tablet, and the format has to work on both. And 38.5% of creators password-protect a page before sending it, which only makes sense for a private, one-to-one invite.

Below, five options are compared on cost, export, watermark, group size and RSVP. Every third-party claim comes from that tool's own page.

## What is an online dandiya invitation card?

An online dandiya invitation card is any invitation to a dandiya raas or garba night that is made and delivered digitally instead of printed. In practice it takes three forms: a still image (PNG or JPEG), a short video, or a link that opens a page in the browser.

The form decides who it suits. An image or video can be forwarded to a group of any size, while a link can carry a question, a reply button and a calendar entry. Sharad Navratri 2026 runs from Sun 11 Oct to Mon 19 Oct, so whichever you pick has nine nights to cover.

## 5 ways to make a digital dandiya invitation

### 1. Adobe Express image card

A browser design tool: edit a template, export an image. It suits a society secretary who wants a polished card for a group.

Adobe's plan table lists a $0 tier with 268,000+ templates (519,000+ on Premium) and JPEG, PNG, PDF and GIF export on every plan. The live page blocked our fetcher, so we read an archived May 2026 copy, which says nothing about watermarks.

### 2. Canva image card

The same job as Adobe Express: pick a festive template, swap the text, export. It suits anyone who already has a Canva login.

Its pricing page title names four tiers: Free, Pro, Business and Enterprise. Every Canva page we tried returned a 403 block, so we cannot say which templates or exports need Pro; check the export screen before designing.

### 3. Kapwing video invite

An online video editor with invitation templates, for a card that moves. It suits a club or college event posting on Instagram.

Kapwing's pricing page says its $0 plan gives unlimited exports with a watermark, videos up to 4 minutes, at 720p. Removing the watermark needs Pro at $16 per member per month billed annually, or $24 monthly.

### 4. A WhatsApp text invite

No design at all: five lines typed into the chat. It suits family or neighbours who already know the venue.

It needs nothing but the chat you already use. Its limit is attention, since a plain line sinks under a day of forwards; our sibling guides on dandiya night invitation messages and garba invitation wording cover the text.

### 5. An interactive one-to-one invitation link

A private page for a single person, sent as a link. It suits asking your partner, crush or best friend to be your dandiya partner.

The Be My Dandiya Partner page's schema marks it `isAccessibleForFree: true`, and the recipient needs no app and no account. Its limit is its point: one person, one question, so it cannot invite a society.

## Cost, export, watermark and RSVP side by side

This table compares the five options on what each one's own page states, read on 12 October 2026 (Adobe from its archived May 2026 copy). Where we could not read a page, the cell says so.

| Option | Cost (own page) | What you export or send | Watermark | Group or one person | RSVP |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Adobe Express | $0 tier; Premium has a 30-day trial | JPEG, PNG, PDF, GIF; video up to 30 min | Not stated in its plan table | Group | None listed |
| Canva | Lists Free, Pro, Business, Enterprise | Not verified (page blocked) | Not verified | Group | None verified |
| Kapwing | $0 plan; Pro $16/member/month annually | Video up to 4 min at 720p | Yes on the $0 plan | Group | None listed |
| WhatsApp text | Your data only | Plain text in chat | None | Group or one | Replies in chat |
| Be My Dandiya Partner link | isAccessibleForFree: true (schema) | Private link plus a 1080×1920 PNG pass | Not listed in its spec | One person | Yes/No, email on first yes, add to calendar |

The takeaway: for a group, the image tools win on reach and the link loses outright. For one person, the link is the only row with a reply built in.

## Which one for a society dandiya night of 200 guests?

Use an image card plus a typed text line, and skip the interactive link. Images are already how Indian WhatsApp groups talk: Garimella and Eckles collected over 5 million messages from more than 5,000 public groups in India between October 2018 and June 2019, and [describe images as a large fraction of what is shared on WhatsApp](https://misinforeview.hks.harvard.edu/article/images-and-misinformation-in-political-groups-evidence-from-whatsapp-in-india/) (political groups, July 2020).

Group chats also carry this kind of content by habit. In a [survey of 633 WhatsApp users](https://www.ojcmt.net/article/group-based-communication-contents-and-practices-of-whatsapp-group-use-by-generations-and-genders-5900), 52.2% said their groups share chain messages such as caricatures, videos, photos and celebration messages (Turkey, 2019; we read the abstract only).

Spend your effort on the date and time, not on decoration. In a field experiment, [employees prompted to write down both the date and time they planned to attend](https://europepmc.org/article/PMC/PMC3127912) were vaccinated at a rate 4.2 percentage points above a 33.1% control group; a date alone gave a 1.5-point difference that was not significant (PNAS, 2011, abstract read). For a dandiya card, that means "Sat, 8 pm, Block C lawn" in the text under the image, so a guest can plan the evening.

Personalising a mass card is weaker than it feels. A randomised trial of 1,511 German doctors found [personalised invitations drew 2.8% participation against 2.4% for generic ones](https://europepmc.org/article/PMC/PMC8590365), a difference that was not statistically significant (2021, abstract read). Different audience, same lesson: a name on a 200-guest card is not what brings people.

## Which one for one person: a crush, partner or garba buddy?

Here the image card is the wrong tool: it cannot ask a question or hear the answer. Everything below comes from the template's own feature list.

You add both names, nine short lines (one for each night of Navratri), a note, up to six photos, and the night's details: date, time, venue and dress code. The recipient clashes a pair of dandiya sticks to open an embroidered envelope, lights nine diyas round a garbo, plays a short dhol-beat game, and picks the colour they will twirl in.

Then comes the question. The No button drops its sticks and twirls away with a new excuse each time, and after five tries it turns into a second Yes. You get an email the first time they say yes, and they get a 1080×1920 PNG Dandiya Pass, Instagram Story size, plus an Add to calendar button for Google Calendar and Apple or Outlook.

Privacy matters more here than on a society card. 38.5% of SubhSandesh creators set a password before sharing, and this page offers one at publish. If that is the invitation you want, make a [Be My Dandiya Partner invitation](https://subhsandesh.in/dandiya-partner) and send the private link on WhatsApp or Instagram.

If garba night is only the first stop of a longer plan, [The Invitation page](https://subhsandesh.in/date-invitation) fits better: a yes turns into a countdown, and on the day the plan unlocks one stop at a time. It is the better pick when the question is the whole evening, not just the dance.

## How late can you make a dandiya invitation?

Later than you think, so speed matters. We have no Navratri creation data yet, so the nearest measurement is Raksha Bandhan 2026 (n = 89, a different, one-day festival): 49.4% of those pages were built on the festival day itself, and the median lead time was 0 days.

Navratri gives you more room than that. The 2026 nights run 11 to 19 Oct, Vijayadashami falls on Tue 20 Oct, and Gujarat plays garba again on Sharad Purnima night, Sun 25 Oct. In 2027 Navratri runs 30 Sep to 8 Oct, with Dussehra on 9 Oct.

The dandiya page's own schema estimates five minutes to make, and a text invite takes one. An image card takes as long as your design patience allows.

## When the interactive link is the wrong choice

First, any group: a society night, an office event, a home puja or a college club. It is a one-to-one invitation, not a group card or a ticketing tool, and it does not sell garba passes or find anyone a partner. Second, a guest who needs Hindi, Gujarati or Marathi throughout: the page interface is English, although every line you write is editable.

Third, a real yes-or-no. Because No turns into Yes after five tries, the page is a playful ask, not an honest RSVP; if the answer might genuinely be no, ask in person. Fourth, a recipient who only checks a phone gallery: 48.3% of our page views are on phones, but a link still needs a tap and a browser, while an image sits in the chat.

## Sources

- Garimella, K. and Eckles, D., "Images and misinformation in political groups: Evidence from WhatsApp in India", HKS Misinformation Review, July 2020.
- Koçak, A. and Yüksek Vergiveren, Ö., "Group-Based Communication: Contents and Practices of WhatsApp Group Use by Generations and Genders", Online Journal of Communication and Media Technologies, 29 Aug 2019.
- Milkman, K. L. et al., "Using implementation intentions prompts to enhance influenza vaccination rates", PNAS, 13 Jun 2011, via Europe PMC.
- Hennrich, P., Arnold, C. and Wensing, M., "Effects of personalized invitation letters on research participation among general practitioners: a randomized trial", BMC Medical Research Methodology, 13 Nov 2021, via Europe PMC.
- SubhSandesh platform data, measured 24 Sep 2026; Raksha Bandhan lead time measured 9 Sep 2026.
